summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by eToro Group Ltd., a BVI-incorporated foreign private issuer, reporting the results of its annual meeting of shareholders held on May 26, 2026. The filing discloses that shareholders approved all proposals, including the amendment and restatement of the company's memorandum and articles of association, which was subsequently filed with the BVI Registrar. The filing also incorporates the document by reference into an existing S-8 registration statement. There is no mention of any merger, acquisition, tender offer, going-private transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, capital return, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special situation. The report is a standard disclosure required under the Exchange Act for a foreign private issuer.
